text.card: A red giant 1,117 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.94 solar masses and 14.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,341 K at its surface.
